prospective_scope: Fixed tasks10 and15 selected because both full corrective outputs were preserved before this analysis. Compare every original/corrective setting and detector, including unchanged rows; report all differences. No equivalence margin or primary tolerance acceptance.
interpretation: Descriptive paired full-run differences on two availability-selected completed corrective tasks. Not a causal isolation of rounding, not cohort equivalence, not an accepted primary aggregate. All original rows checked against exact upward float32 conversion envelope; all corrective rows satisfy original strict bound. No tolerance added to primary aggregator.
